beta_findings: LOCK/RENEW LIMITATION (surfaced during drive): src/session-lock.js renew() uses pid+hostname holder identity, but the orchestrator-as-driver model runs each acquire/renew/release in a FRESH node subprocess (Bash `node -e`), so every call has a different process.pid. Consequence: renew() always no-ops (foreign pid) and the lock cannot be kept fresh across orchestrator turns; after the 5-min staleness window it must be re-acquired (which works because a stale lock is re-takeable). The lock design implicitly assumes a single persistent holding process. Fine for single-orchestrator local drive (advisory), but a real finding — candidate follow-up against TASK-061/062: support an explicit stable holder identity (e.g. session_id or a caller-supplied token) instead of process.pid so renew works across ephemeral driver processes.
